The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking to quash the notification dated 20.10.2022 issued by the Sub-Collector, Bhawanipatna under Annexure-1 and to issue direction to the opposite parties to pay compensation and other benefits as per the provisions contained under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 4. Mr. B. Paramguru, learned counsel for the petitioner contended that for construction over the land in question, compensation has already been paid to the petitioner.

But the other benefits, as per the provisions contained under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, have not been paid to the petitioner.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Therefore, she has approached this Court by filing the present writ petition.

5. Mr. M. Mishra, learned Senior Counsel appearing along with Mr. T. Mishra, learned counsel states that he has got instruction to appear on behalf of the opposite party no.5 and, as such, he has filed memorandum in Court today, which be taken on record.
It is contended that since the benefit has already been extended to one of the co-sharers, the petitioner is not entitled to claim any benefit.

6. sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner has approached this Court, without approaching the authority, claiming the said benefit, as due and admissible to her.

7. In such view of the matter, this Court disposes of the writ petition permitting the petitioner to approach the authority concerned claiming the other benefits, as have been claimed in this writ petition, by filing a comprehensive representation within two weeks from today.

If such an application is filed, along with a certified copy of this order, the concerned authority shall consider the same and pass a reasoned and speaking order as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of three months from the date of its receipt.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
